subject: Request: Purge of assistant artifacts (prompts, outputs, logs) — Horizon Tech
messages:
From: Julia Park <julia@horizontech.com>
To: mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-07T09:12:00-04:00
Subject: Purge request — assistant prompts/outputs/logs

Hi Mina,

We need Redwood to execute a scoped purge for Horizon Tech under the EU tenancy. The ask: delete all prompt/input traces, assistant outputs, and inference logs tied to project code HT-881 across the last 24 months. We also need chain-of-custody proof and an S3 deletion audit CSV.

Attached is our initial scope spreadsheet (htc_purge_scope.xlsx) with the identifiers we currently have. Can you confirm timeline, required approvals, and whether KV/prefix caching needs manual invalidation?

Thanks,
Julia Park
Dir. of Data Privacy — Horizon Tech
julia@horizontech.com

---
Attachments: htc_purge_scope.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: mina_haddad@redwood.ai
To: Julia Park <julia@horizontech.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-07T10:02:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Purge request — assistant prompts/outputs/logs

Hi Julia — thanks for the scope doc. We can run this purge from our EU deployment. Quick notes and next steps: 

- Scope verification: Ben (Ops) and Neha (Security) to validate the identifiers and whether any requests intersect retention holds.
- Timeline: target completion within 48–72 hours after sign-off. If there are queued long-term backups, there may be an extended window for certificate delivery (we'll surface that up front).
- KV/prefix caches: We will invalidate prefix caches and K/V entries that map to the HT-881 prefixes; that is a coordinated step and will be included in the runbook.
- Proof: we will provide a purge_manifest JSON and an S3-deletion-log CSV, plus a signed MD5 bundle for artifacts.

Ben/neha — please review the attached runbook draft (purge_runbook_v1.2.pdf) and confirm there are no retention holds on the listed datasets. Julia — once we have sign-off, we will schedule the run and send the canary verification link.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Sr. Privacy & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai

---
Attachments: purge_runbook_v1.2.pdf (PDF runbook)

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: mina_haddad@redwood.ai, Julia Park <julia@horizontech.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-07T14:41:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Purge request — assistant prompts/outputs/logs (ops checklist)

All — I reviewed the scope. Confirmations:

- Identifiers in htc_purge_scope.xlsx map to ingestion batches in EU region 'eu-central-1' (confirmed).
- No legal/retention holds surfaced in the records we can see; Neha, flag if you find anything.
- Run steps (high-level): 1) Lock writes to affected model endpoints; 2) snapshot current KV index; 3) invalidate prefix/KV caches; 4) execute S3 object deletion by manifest; 5) run rollback smoke tests and generate proof bundle.

I plan to run a dry-run in our staging environment tonight and will attach the execution manifest after the production run. ETA for production window: 2026-09-08 23:00–23:30 UTC.

Ben Carter
Ops — Redwood Inference
---
Attachments: none

From: ops@redwood.ai
To: Julia Park <julia@horizontech.com>, mina_haddad@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-09T11:08:00-04:00
Subject: Purge run complete — manifest and audit logs attached

Hi team,

The production purge for HT-881 completed at 2026-09-09T03:18:42Z (EU cluster). Deliverables attached: purge_manifest_20260909.json, s3_deletion_log_20260909.csv. Summary:

- Objects deleted: 14,322 (prompts/inputs), 8,410 (assistant outputs), 21,200 (inference logs/rotating traces)
- KV prefixes invalidated: ht-881/prompt/* and ht-881/kv/*
- Cache flush completed across edge nodes (ttl expired invalidations forced)

Proof artifacts (included in purge_manifest_20260909.json): per-object SHA256, deletion timestamp, operator ID, runbook version. Also attached a signed checksum bundle (embedded in manifest) and the S3 deletion CSV.

Notes and exceptions:
- Two objects previously archived to Glacier Deep Archive as part of a customer backup retention were not immediately deletable by the standard API. We initiated an expedited deletion request; confirmation is pending from our storage provider. These two items are listed in the manifest under 'pending_provider_deletes'. We expect final provider confirmation within 5 business days and will push an updated manifest when received.

If you need additional notarized evidence (e.g., KMS key zeroization statement), open a support ticket and we will escalate.

Regards,
Redwood Ops (automated run reporter)
ops@redwood.ai

---
Attachments: purge_manifest_20260909.json (JSON manifest), s3_deletion_log_20260909.csv (CSV audit)

Date: 2026-09-09T17:28:00-04:00

Mina / Ben / Ops — thank you. Confirming receipt of the manifest and CSV. We reviewed the attached manifest and the two 'pending_provider_deletes' entries reference archive IDs A-881-GL-01 and A-881-GL-02. Horizon Privacy will accept the expedited provider deletion confirmation once received.

Final acceptance checklist we need for closure:
- Manifest with per-object hashes (received)
- S3 deletion CSV (received)
- Provider confirmation for archived objects (pending)
- A short statement from Redwood confirming the KV/prefix invalidation procedure run (can be a single-paragraph emailed statement)

Once provider confirmation is back, I will reply-all to sign off. For now this thread serves as our audit trail.

Thanks — Julia
Julia Park
Dir. of Data Privacy — Horizon Tech
